structured.feedback: I'd ship this one. It's about 200 words of Markdown with keyword-rich subheadings and separate sections for features and benefits. It uses active voice and ends with a call to action. It drops the shakier source claims (reducing fine lines, fighting UV damage) and hedges the radiance claim with "may help." It mentions none of the product's weaknesses, invents no quotes, includes no links, and borrows only a little from the reviews (the cocoa scent and softer skin).
